trade.text: He said tariffs had destroyed overseas markets for agricultural products and criticized the policy.
trade.quote: The tariffs that we’ve instituted have destroyed our overseas markets

schools.text: He said he was against school vouchers.
schools.quote: Coover said he was against school vouchers and opposed redistricting efforts.

tax.text: His campaign says he would extend tax relief for families, small businesses, farmers, and ranchers.
tax.quote: Fighting to curb runaway federal spending, lower inflation, and extend tax relief for Kansas families, small businesses, and farmers and ranchers through the Working Families Tax Cut.

safety.text: He called for funding school security improvements and putting more police officers in schools that want them.
safety.quote: He also wants to put more police officers in schools that want them.

immigration.text: He cosponsored and voted for the Laken Riley Act, which requires detention and deportation for certain noncitizens charged with crimes.
immigration.quote: S. 5 will make communities in Kansas and across the country safer by requiring the detention and deportation of illegal immigrants

guns.text: He cosponsored bills to expand concealed-carry reciprocity and reduce federal restrictions on firearms and firearm businesses.
guns.quote: The Constitution is clear that Americans’ Second Amendment rights shall not be infringed,

abortion.text: He said he wanted Kansas to have fewer abortions and supported defending existing abortion restrictions.
abortion.quote: I am for a Kansas that has fewer abortions — not more,

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He said he would sign a bill barring athletes identified male at birth from competing in girls’ and women’s sports.
gender.quote: People who are biologically male should not be allowed to compete in sports that are reserved for female athletes.

tax.text: He calls for eliminating the federal income tax and drastically cutting spending.
tax.quote: Eliminate federal income tax and drastically cut spending
